Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.468.0/aosward-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aosward-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aosward-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '2bc4049b78b809c4d1b962ce90518d62715c6506a85374f1982e9aa78d65e53d') { throw 'aosward checksum mismatch' }

Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.468.0/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '782c8923a51a29efa76629797ea4b59e83430958d4357665b6fb692e01930c94') { throw 'aosguard checksum mismatch' }
